title: IPD projects share cost savings across companies, aligning stakeholders on collective document management
content:
Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) projects involve multiple disciplines working together from the beginning — clients, construction masters, consultants (DT BAU, 01:15:53).

The governing documents (BEP) are **discussed and agreed collectively** in IPD, contrasting with traditional projects that suffer from conflicts (01:27:36). What makes that collaboration real rather than aspirational is the incentive structure: **cost savings are shared among participating companies**, encouraging genuine team collaboration and collective document management (01:28:55).

Two implications for a document-model platform:
- Multi-party documents with attributable history map directly onto IPD's collective authorship needs — every stakeholder edit is visible and accountable.
- Incentive-aligned projects are the most receptive early market for shared, live documents; adversarial traditional contracts are the least.
description: Integrated Project Delivery involves all disciplines from the start and shares cost savings among firms — the financial incentive that makes collective BEP authoring actually work.
